params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.feed
params.description: Required. The new values of feed details. It must match an existing feed and the field name must be in the format of: projects/project_number/feeds/feed_id or folders/folder_number/feeds/feed_id or organizations/organization_number/feeds/feed_id.

params.name: data.update_mask
params.description: Required. Only updates the feed fields indicated by this mask. The field mask must not be empty, and it must not contain fields that are immutable or only set by the server.

methods.name: getFeed
